name: Developer Essentials
description: A practical workstation bootstrap for developers: Arch build basics, Git and GitHub CLI, fast shell search tools, terminal workflow helpers, C/C++ build and debug tools, major language runtimes, Docker, and Visual Studio Code.

items.summary: Arch's essential build toolchain group for compiling AUR packages and local projects.
